first_attempt.result: Built and patched, but verification refused the generated extension R class; the successor explicitly permits that generated namespace.

scope: Exact bootstrap, original-result wrapper, feature markers and four optional decoder guard prefixes checked; remaining original code, handlers, resources, native files and assets compared. Debug items and signing were outside comparison.

Settings Activity has no manifest declaration or in-app navigation
No complete FLAC download/provider acceptance, whole-file codec proof or Move implementation
No same-signer update or verified handoff of the installed app's private downloads
Hosted prototype only; existing public release/feed was not changed
